name: Kousaka Chihaya
source: A girl who the protagonist met in a coffee shop. They become friends soon and then she even becomes his girlfriend. Due to a mysterious accident her memory can be kept for three days only. Chihaya always looks bright and has a kind personality, and always meets a people with a bright smile.
translation: A girl who the protagonist met in a coffee shop. They become friends soon and then she even becomes his girlfriend. Due to a mysterious accident her memory can be kept for three days only. Chihaya always looks bright and has a kind personality, and always meets a people with a bright smile.
